objective: Produce five 300-700 character self-introduction sets for the AI service engineer role, retain only 90+ sets, and make technology mechanisms, evidence boundaries, and evaluation meaning explicit.

included: read-only repository structure and source evidence
five candidate sets with three answers each
excluded: inventing personal metrics, ownership, production operation, or customer outcomes
private prompts, transcripts, secrets, runtime handles, or provider credentials

routing.coordination: Orca supervised Run with three read-only worker lanes and one integration owner
routing.ownership: single integration writer for artifacts and PDF; workers do not edit files
routing.validation: hard gates plus non-compensatory mechanism/evidence/interview micro-gates
stopConditions: all five sets pass the 90 threshold and hard gates
any claim that cannot be supported is rewritten as bounded inference or future intent
no direct Chat Gateway→Reporting claim remains without integration evidence
PDF is rendered and checked for page layout and character counts
remaining uncertainty is recorded as applicant confirmation, not silently resolved

roles.purpose: Extract job responsibilities, qualifications, company business context, HR values, and application constraints from official pages.
roles.output: source-backed role context and safe narrative implications

roles.purpose: Map repository structure, runtime surfaces, quality controls, and scale while separating source facts from authorship and run-result claims.
nonGoals: assign personal ownership from Git metadata
roles.output: evidence map with paths, claim class, safe wording, and exclusions

roles.purpose: Review each technology as a problem-solving mechanism with boundary, causal flow, failure behavior, and operational implication.
nonGoals: turn tests into evidence of successful operation without a run artifact
roles.output: mechanism map, claim ledger rules, and rejection/caveat list

roles.purpose: Turn evidence into five distinct but coherent sets: capability, project proof, and value-in-organization.
nonGoals: copy a stack list into prose
merge separate bounded services into one unsupported flow
roles.output: content JSON and rendered self-introduction draft

roles.purpose: Score each set using weighted axes and non-compensatory micro-gates; exclude any set below 90.
nonGoals: offset evidence/mechanism hard failures with style points
roles.output: versioned rubric with score meaning and disposition

roles.purpose: Validate Unicode character ranges, JSON consistency, PDF page layout, and visible score/selection labels.
nonGoals: change content to hide a failed gate

stages.name: parallel_evidence_collection
stages.exit: evidence map and mechanism map are available

stages.name: narrative_architecture
checks: technical mechanisms translated to business/operation meaning
stages.exit: candidate thesis: AI features into usable, operable services

stages.name: five_set_generation
checks: no technology list without causal verb

stages.name: adversarial_mechanism_and_claim_review
stages.exit: revised drafts have no known hard mechanism/evidence failures

stages.name: document_render_and_quality_gate
stages.exit: PDF and machine-readable companion artifacts are ready

tooling.research: official-source web research with direct citations
tooling.repository: rg, package manifests, architecture READMEs, source path inspection
tooling.validation: Node JSON/Unicode checks, Playwright A4 PDF rendering, image inspection

applicantFollowUp: confirm owned modules and changed files
confirm which checks were actually run and when
add a real result/metric only if available
prepare one failure and one rejected alternative per project answer
